items.title: Gerald Wiggins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 2, 1995
items.q: I even was with Dinah Shore one night.

ctx.x: Interesting. You have accompanied along the way some great singers, too.
Yeah, I’ve been with Lena Horne, Dinah Washington, Kay Starr, I even was with Dinah Shore one night. And let’s see who else. So many I forget most of them, yeah.
Did you ever cross paths with Joe Williams?
